summary: This is a two-channel arbitrary/function generator controlled by an ESP32-S3 DevKit with an ILI9341 touch TFT and a rotary encoder. Each channel takes an AD9833 DDS waveform, conditions it to a bipolar ±12V-domain signal, sets its amplitude with an AD5452 multiplying DAC, adds a DC offset from an MCP4822 DAC, and drives a relay-switched 50Ω output on a coax connector and header.

blocks.name: power-input
blocks.purpose: 12V barrel-jack input with a push-button power switch feeding the switched +12C rail.

blocks.name: bipolar-supply
blocks.purpose: Isolated DC-DC converter makes ±12V for the analog signal chain, with bulk and local decoupling on both rails.

blocks.name: logic-supply
blocks.purpose: LM7805 derives +5V from +12C and an AP2112 LDO derives +3.3V from +5V for logic, DDS modules, DACs and the display.

blocks.name: mcu
blocks.purpose: ESP32-S3 DevKit runs the UI and programs all DDS and DAC chips over a shared SPI bus.

blocks.name: user-interface
blocks.purpose: ILI9341 TFT with resistive-touch controller plus a rotary encoder module for user input.

blocks.name: dds-sources
blocks.purpose: Two AD9833 DDS modules generate the raw CH1/CH2 waveforms, routed through a dual analog switch that either passes them directly or through an attenuator.

blocks.name: center-bias
blocks.purpose: Filtered 0.423V reference, buffered by U15, which is subtracted from the DDS signal to remove its DC midpoint.

blocks.name: ch1-gain
blocks.purpose: U4A removes the DDS DC level with ~5x gain and U4B adds 4x gain to produce the bipolar reference for CH1's multiplying DAC.

blocks.name: ch2-gain
blocks.purpose: Same level-shift and gain stage for CH2.

blocks.name: ch1-amplitude-offset
blocks.purpose: AD5452 with U5A as I-to-V converter sets CH1 amplitude, and U5B sums it with a scaled DAC offset and a +5V shift to drive CH1.

blocks.name: ch2-amplitude-offset
blocks.purpose: Same amplitude and offset stage for CH2 using U13 and U12.

blocks.name: offset-dac
blocks.purpose: Dual 12-bit MCP4822 provides the DC-offset control voltages for both channels.

blocks.name: output-switching
blocks.purpose: GPIO-driven relays connect each channel through a 49.9Ω series resistor to its coax and header outputs.

parts.J3: Barrel-jack 12V input; pin 2 goes to the power switch and pin 1 to ground.
parts.SW2: Push-button SPST power switch that connects the jack to the +12C rail.
parts.C1: Input capacitor on +12C for the LM7805 and the DC-DC converter.
parts.U2: TMR 6-1222 DC-DC converter producing +12V and -12V (COMMON to GND) from +12C; REMOTE pin is left unconnected.
parts.U16: AP2112K-3.3 600mA LDO making +3.3V from +5V; EN is tied to VIN so it is always on.
parts.C2: 100n decoupling on the +5V rail at the 7805 output and LDO input.
parts.C33: 1µ capacitor on +3.3V at the LDO output.
parts.R31: 0Ω link connecting the board's +3.3V rail to the DevKit's 3V3 pins, which ties the external LDO in parallel with the DevKit's own 3.3V output.
parts.U1: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-N16R8 that runs the UI, drives the display SPI, the shared DDS/DAC SPI bus, the analog-switch selects and the relay drivers, and is powered from +5V.
parts.DS1: ILI9341 TFT module with touch controller; display and touch share SCK (GPIO4) and MOSI (GPIO5), and display MISO is not used.
parts.SW1: Rotary encoder module (A/B/push) on GPIO1/2/42, powered from +3.3V.
parts.U6: AD9833 DDS module generating the raw CH1 waveform, selected by FSYNC on GPIO10.
parts.U7: AD9833 DDS module generating the raw CH2 waveform, selected by FSYNC on GPIO39.
parts.SW3: TS5A23157 dual SPDT analog switch that passes each DDS output either directly (NC) or through the 39.2k/10k attenuator (NO), controlled by GPIO21 for CH1 and GPIO47 for CH2.
parts.R3: 39.2k top resistor of the CH1 attenuator (~0.203x), likely used to scale the AD9833's full-swing square output (3.3V × 0.203 ≈ 0.67Vpp) to the sine/triangle level.
parts.R4: 10k bottom resistor of the CH1 attenuator; it also sets the DC path to ground at U4's input.
parts.R16: 39.2k top resistor of the CH2 attenuator.
parts.R17: 10k bottom resistor of the CH2 attenuator.
parts.U15: OPA2810 used as a unity-gain buffer that drives CENTER_BIAS from the 0.423V divider.
parts.R25: 68.1k top resistor of the 0.423V center-bias divider from +3.3V.
parts.R26: 10k bottom resistor of the center-bias divider.
parts.C15: 1µ filter capacitor on the bias divider tap to remove noise from the 3.3V rail.
parts.U4: OPA2810 dual for CH1: U4A is a difference stage (out ≈ 5·func_in − 4·CENTER_BIAS) and U4B is a non-inverting ×4 stage that drives the AD5452 VREF.
parts.R5: 499Ω gain resistor from CENTER_BIAS into U4A IN−; it sets the ~5x gain and subtracts the bias.
parts.R9: 1k ground leg of U4B's gain network (gain = 1 + 3k/1k = 4).
parts.U11: OPA2810 dual for CH2, doing the same difference and ×4 gain stages as U4.
parts.R21: 1k ground leg of U11B's ×4 gain network.
parts.U8: AD5452 12-bit multiplying DAC that scales CH1's bipolar gained_func reference to set the amplitude; chip select is GPIO9.
parts.U13: AD5452 multiplying DAC that sets CH2 amplitude; chip select is GPIO40.
parts.U5: OPA2810 dual for CH1: U5A is the current-to-voltage converter for the AD5452 IOUT (feedback via the DAC's RFB), and U5B is the summing output stage that drives CH1.
parts.C21: 1.5pF feedback compensation across U5A for stability with the DAC output capacitance.
parts.R29: 4.02k input resistor that feeds U5A's output into U5B's summing node.
parts.R12: 4.02k resistor injecting +5V into U5B's summing node, giving a −5V output shift.
parts.R13: 4.02k feedback resistor of U5B; with equal resistors, CH1 ≈ 3·dc_offset − 5V − V(U5A).
parts.R11: 1k resistor that forms an RC low-pass with C20 on the CH1 offset voltage from DAC_A.
parts.C20: 100n filter capacitor on the CH1 offset input to U5B IN+.
parts.U12: OPA2810 dual for CH2, working as the I-to-V converter and offset summing output stage like U5.
parts.R30: 4.02k input resistor from U12A into CH2's summing node.
parts.R14: 4.02k resistor injecting +5V into CH2's summing node.
parts.R15: 1k RC filter resistor on the CH2 offset voltage from DAC_B.
parts.C24: 100n filter capacitor on the CH2 offset input to U12B IN+.
parts.U17: MCP4822 dual 12-bit voltage DAC providing DAC_A/DAC_B offset voltages; ~LDAC is grounded so outputs update when CS rises, and chip select is GPIO14.
parts.R7: 10k pull-up that holds U8 SYNC inactive while the ESP32 boots.
parts.R23: 10k pull-up that holds U13 SYNC inactive while the ESP32 boots.
parts.R24: 10k pull-up that holds U17 CS inactive while the ESP32 boots.
parts.SW4: 5V relay that switches CH1 (COM) through to the output resistor R1 via contact B; contact A is unused.
parts.SW5: 5V relay that switches CH2 through to output resistor R2.
parts.Q1: 2N3904 low-side driver for relay SW4's coil, controlled by GPIO41.
parts.Q2: 2N3904 low-side driver for relay SW5's coil, controlled by GPIO13.
parts.D1: Flyback diode across SW4's coil (cathode to +5V) that clamps the turn-off spike at Q1's collector.
parts.D2: Flyback diode across SW5's coil that protects Q2.
parts.R8: 1k base resistor that limits GPIO41 drive current into Q1.
parts.R27: 47k base pull-down that keeps Q1 (and so the relay) off while GPIO41 is floating.
parts.R28: 1k base resistor for Q2 from GPIO13.
parts.R32: 47k base pull-down that keeps Q2 off at boot.
parts.R1: 49.9Ω 2512 series resistor that sets a ~50Ω source impedance for the CH1 output.
parts.R2: 49.9Ω 2512 series resistor that sets a ~50Ω source impedance for the CH2 output.
parts.J4: 2-pin header carrying the CH1 output in parallel with J1.
parts.J5: 2-pin header carrying the CH2 output in parallel with J2.

nets.+12C: Switched raw 12V input after SW2, which supplies both the ±12V DC-DC converter and the 7805.
nets.+12V: Positive analog supply from U2 for all OPA2810 op-amps.
nets.-12V: Negative analog supply from U2 for the op-amps; it is decoupled by C4/C6/C10/C12/C14/C34–C36 even though the net is typed as a signal.
nets.+5V: 7805 output that feeds the LDO, ESP32 DevKit, relay coils, and the +5V shift injection into the output summers.
nets.+3.3V: LDO output that powers the DDS modules, DACs, analog switch, display, encoder, and the bias divider.
nets.Net-(R31-Pad1): Connects the DevKit 3V3 pins to the board +3.3V rail through the 0Ω link R31.
nets.CENTER_BIAS: Buffered 0.423V reference subtracted in U4A/U11A so that the DDS signal's DC midpoint maps to about 0V after gain.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/func_in: Selected CH1 DDS signal (direct or attenuated) that enters the non-inverting input of U4A.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/func_in: Selected CH2 DDS signal that enters U11A.
nets.Net-(SW3A-NO1): Path from the CH1 switch to the 39.2k/10k attenuator.
nets.Net-(SW3B-NO2): Path from the CH2 switch to its attenuator.
nets.Net-(SW3A-COM1): Raw AD9833 U6 output into the CH1 analog switch.
nets.Net-(SW3B-COM2): Raw AD9833 U7 output into the CH2 analog switch.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/gained_func: Bipolar, ~20x-gained CH1 waveform used as the AD5452 VREF, so the DAC code scales the amplitude.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/gained_func: Bipolar gained CH2 waveform used as U13's VREF.
nets.Net-(U5A-IN-): AD5452 IOUT current summing node held at virtual ground by U5A.
nets.Net-(U5A-OUT): Amplitude-scaled CH1 voltage; it is the DAC's RFB return and feeds the output summer through R29.
nets.Net-(U12A-OUT): Amplitude-scaled CH2 voltage, which is U13's RFB return and the summer input via R30.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/5V_ref: U5B inverting summing node that combines +5V, the scaled waveform, and CH1 feedback through equal 4.02k resistors.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/5V_ref: U12B inverting summing node for CH2.
nets.DAC_A: MCP4822 channel A output that sets the CH1 DC offset.
nets.DAC_B: MCP4822 channel B output that sets the CH2 DC offset.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH1/dc_offset: RC-filtered offset voltage on U5B IN+; it contributes 3× to the CH1 output, against a −5V shift.
nets./Function_Generation/FG_CH2/dc_offset: RC-filtered offset voltage on U12B IN+ for CH2.
nets.CH1: Final CH1 op-amp output that goes to relay SW4's common contact.
nets.CH2: Final CH2 op-amp output that goes to relay SW5's common contact.
nets.Net-(SW4B-B): Relay-switched CH1 signal into the 49.9Ω output resistor.
nets.Net-(J1-In): CH1 50Ω-terminated output that drives the coax J1 and header J4.
nets.Net-(J2-In): CH2 50Ω-terminated output that drives the coax J2 and header J5.
nets.Net-(D1-A): Low side of SW4's coil, switched by Q1 and clamped by D1.
nets.Net-(D2-A): Low side of SW5's coil, switched by Q2 and clamped by D2.
nets.GPIO41: Output-enable control for CH1's relay driver.
nets.GPIO13: Output-enable control for CH2's relay driver.
nets.GPIO21: Selects direct or attenuated DDS signal for CH1 on SW3.
nets.GPIO47: Selects direct or attenuated DDS signal for CH2 on SW3.
nets.GPIO11: Shared SPI MOSI to both AD9833s, both AD5452s, and the MCP4822.
nets.GPIO12: Shared SPI clock to both AD9833s, both AD5452s, and the MCP4822.
nets.GPIO10: FSYNC chip select for the CH1 AD9833 (U6).
nets.GPIO39: FSYNC chip select for the CH2 AD9833 (U7).
nets.GPIO9: SYNC chip select for the CH1 AD5452 (U8), pulled up by R7.
nets.GPIO40: SYNC chip select for the CH2 AD5452 (U13), pulled up by R23.
nets.GPIO14: Chip select for the MCP4822 offset DAC, pulled up by R24.
nets.GPIO4: SPI clock shared by the TFT and its touch controller.
nets.GPIO5: SPI MOSI shared by the TFT and its touch controller.
nets.GPIO6: Touch controller data output back to the ESP32.
